title: Weak localization in pure and Cr-doped MoS2 macroparticles probed through a low field magnetoimpedance effect
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,21326-21340
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01619C, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
A. K. Swetha, Rajesh Cheruku, K. P. Shinde, Ki Buem Kim, Y. Jo, Rajeev Shesha Joshi
Globular MoS2 with Cr doping, having flaky texture, was studied through AC magnetoelectric transport to identify weak charge localization that is not identified using magnetic measurements, to establish inhomogeneity-driven magnetoelectric coupling.
